content:
FINAL AUTONOMOUS COMPLETION — REMOVE THE LAST PARTIAL STATUS

The Autonomous report is very close to complete.

Everything else is PASS.

The only remaining item is:

JOB PERSISTENCE = PARTIAL

Complete it end-to-end.

Requirements:

1. Persist EVERY autonomous run into the production database.

Each execution must permanently save:

- Job ID
- Worker ID
- Engine
- Start time
- Finish time
- Status
- Runtime
- Records discovered
- Records inserted
- Records updated
- Errors
- Source URLs
- Evidence artifact
- Commit SHA
- Deployment SHA

2. Remove the limitation where hundreds of runs complete without evidence.

3. Store evidence in Supabase (or the production persistence layer), not only in temporary files.

4. Verify persistence survives:
- server restart
- Render redeploy
- scheduler restart

5. Execute every autonomous engine once:

- Buyer
- Investor
- JV
- Tokenized
- Outreach
- Technology

Return the database record ID for every execution.

6. Update the Autonomous Dashboard so every run can be opened and inspected.

7. Run full QA.

Acceptance Criteria:

✓ No PARTIAL status remaining.
✓ Every autonomous run has permanent evidence.
✓ Dashboard displays historical executions.
✓ Restart does not lose history.
✓ Final report shows:

Job Persistence: PASS
CRM Sync: PASS
Autonomous Dashboard: PASS
Evidence Persistence: PASS

Only mark COMPLETE when every autonomous execution has permanent, verifiable evidence stored in production.
